evidence_layers.saved_command: Coding software heads are statically parsed saved command components from PUBLIC-TRACE-OPERATIONS-v3; command occurrence != successful execution.

evidence_layers.implementation: DocOps libraries are counted only for specifically named interfaces mapped to the frozen/readback-verified runtime implementation; generic inspect_document is not attributed to one library.
evidence_layers.unknown: No product/software is inferred from file extensions, generic computer actions, package requirements, or workload-template placeholders.
